==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Outside the village I discovered a volcanic jungle area. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)
A tribe of Were-Dragons were trying to enslave a tribe of Were-Dinos. (Were-Dragons resemble humanoid dragons, covered in scales, with whiskers and antenna.) (Were-Dinos resemble humanoid dinosaurs covered in scales and dressed in tribal attire.)
I stopped the Were-Dragons by using the Reality Warping Stone to command a pack of wild full-sized dinosaurs to fend them off.
